summary: The Deer Park School District opposes any reduction or restriction of the E‑Rate program, consultant fee limits, federal control over classroom technology, a short comment period, and additional administrative burdens. The commenter opposes sunset or restriction of E‑Rate, limits on consultant compensation, and screen‑time limits; urges a longer comment period and scalable administrative rules.
